I bet there's a hyperdrive we can strip for parts.|translated=1|Manju, to Meevid|}} '''Manju''' was a [[human]] [[scavenger]] who lived during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[132 BBY]], Manju hiked through a [[forest]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Khofar]] with the scavenger [[Meevid]]. When they came across a crashed [[starship]], Manju hoped to find a [[hyperdrive]] to strip for parts within it. However, the two scavengers fled after encountering the [[Wookiee]] [[Jedi]] [[Kelnacca]], who was using the wreck as a [[Kelnacca's shelter|shelter]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|We're lost. I can't believe I let you talk me into coming here.|translated=1|Meevid, to Manju|}} [[File:SneakyWookiee-RevengeJustice.png|thumb|300px|right|The scavengers encountered the Wookiee Kelnacca on Khofar.]] Manju was a [[human]] [[scavenger]] who lived during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} Manju, along with the scavenger [[Meevid]], hiked through a [[forest]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Khofar]] after being lured there by the many [[Starship|ships]] caught in its [[Plant|thickets]] As they walked, Meevid complained to Manju that they were lost and that he{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}} {{AD|Disney+}} could not believe they had talked him into going there. Manju then noticed a crashed starship, which, unbeknownst to the scavengers, was being used as a [[Kelnacca's shelter|shelter]] by the [[Wookiee]] [[Jedi]] [[Kelnacca]], and suggested they may be able to find a [[hyperdrive]] in it to strip for parts. As they approached the wreck, the scavengers noticed a sign that [[Writing|read]] "Keep Out" in [[Shyriiwook]],{{SW|url=series/the-acolyte/revenge-justice-episode-guide|text="Revenge / Justice" Episode Guide | The Acolyte}} but the pair were unable to read it. They were then approached by Kelnacca, who roared at them, causing Meevid to draw his [[blaster]]. Kelnacca responded by [[Telekinesis|Force pulling]] the blaster from his [[Limb|hands]] and breaking it in two, causing the scavengers to flee. ==Personality and traits== Manju was a human with [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s and dark skin. They were cowardly and fled from Kelnacca. ==Skills and abilities== {{Quote|What does it say?''"
"''How should I know?|translated=1|Meevid and Manju, after noticing a sign written in Shyriiwook|}} Manju spoke [[Huttese]] and could not read [[Wookiee script|Shyriiwook]]. ==Equipment== Manju wore a red [[Clothing|vest]], brown pants, and a brown [[hat]]. They carried equipment including a bag and a bundled [[Flexorcord|flexor cord]]. ==Behind the scenes== Manju first appeared in "[[Revenge / Justice]]," the second episode of the [[2024]] [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]],'' which aired on [[June 4]], 2024,{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}} and was portrayed by [[Jumayn Hunter]]. Manju was identified in ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', a [[2025]] reference book by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. The Khofar scenes including Manju were shot at [[Shinfield Studios]],{{Lucasfilm|url=news/lucasfilm-on-location-the-acolyte|text=Lucasfilm on Location: ''The Acolyte''}} [[Wikipedia:England|England]].{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}} Storyboards of the sequence including the scavenger were created by [[Jim Cornish]].{{WebCite|url=https://www.jdcillustration.com/the-acolyte|text=The Acolyte|work=[https://www.jdcillustration.com/home JDC Illustration Ltd]|archivedate=20250320040832}} ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' |storyboards= File:ScavengerStoryboard1-JimCornish.png|Storyboard, Jim Cornish File:ScavengerStoryboard2-JimCornish.png|Storyboard, Jim Cornish File:ScavengerStoryboard3-JimCornish.png|Storyboard, Jim Cornish File:ScavengerStoryboard4-JimCornish.png|Storyboard, Jim Cornish File:ScavengerStoryboard5-JimCornish.png|Storyboard, Jim Cornish |concept= |digital= |in-progress= }} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Manju}} *{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{InsiderCite|229|Star Wars: The Acolyte Companion|''Star Wars: The Acolyte'' Companion}} {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|Manju}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Manju |fr=Manju |ka=მანჯუ }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Scavengers]]
